profile.name: NI数据采集设备
profile.description: 这是一类用于实验室测量、控制与信号采集的多功能数据采集硬件，可提供模拟输入、模拟输出、数字输入/输出以及计数器/定时器功能。它常用于连接传感器、执行器和测试电路，完成电压、电流、电阻、频率、桥式传感器等信号的采集，以及触发、定时和校准相关实验任务。
profile.description_en: This is a family of multifunction data acquisition hardware used in laboratories for measurement, control, and signal acquisition. It provides analog input, analog output, digital I/O, and counter/timer functions, and is commonly used to connect sensors, actuators, and test circuits for acquiring voltage, current, resistance, frequency, and bridge-based signals, as well as for triggering, timing, and calibration tasks.

registry.description: Device Alternate Constructor是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、复位、状态查询、设备连接、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, accessory product nums等操作。
